# Covenant Wealth Australian Retirement Planner

## What this is

A free, browser-based educational tool that helps Australians model their retirement finances. Built by Tudor Cosma CFP (19 years experience) at Covenant Wealth.

## Intended audience

- Australians planning for retirement (DIY users and clients of Covenant Wealth)
- Financial planners seeking a reference model for superannuation, tax, and Centrelink calculations

## What the tool covers

- Superannuation (accumulation and account-based pension drawdown, concessional/non-concessional contributions, contribution tax)
- Australian income tax (FY 2025-26 brackets, LITO, LMITO, Medicare levy and surcharge)
- Centrelink age pension (assets test, income test, deeming, gifting rules)
- Year-by-year retirement cashflow projection in today's dollars (real terms)
- Stress testing via Monte Carlo simulation
- Scenario comparison ("Now" vs "After Advice")
- Goals tracking (retirement, housing, debt payoff, education, sabbatical, travel, big purchases)
- Liabilities and loan payoff modelling
- Return profiles and editable legislative parameters

## Disclaimer

This tool is for **educational purposes only** and does not constitute financial advice. Users should consult a licensed financial adviser before making investment, superannuation, or retirement decisions.
